title: Pancreatic Islet RNA Extraction
author: Islet and Pancreas Analysis Core
license_note: Confirmed via CrossRef DOI metadata: dx.doi.org/10.17504/protocols.io.b2r9qd96
materials: Discard LCM Additive from DNase Kit.

steps.title: Islet Collection and Washing
steps.instruction: Pick at least 75 islets (free of acinar tissue and debris) into an RNase-free microcentrifuge tube.

substeps.instruction: Centrifuge islets for 00:03:00 at 200 rcf, 4 °C.
Remove supernatant and add 1 mL cold RNase-free PBS.
Repeat the centrifugation and PBS wash twice more for a total of 3 PBS washes.

steps.title: Lysis
steps.instruction: Remove supernatant and add 200 mL Lysis Solution, then vortex to mix.

steps.title: Prepare Elution Solution
steps.instruction: Pre-heat the required volume of Elution Solution in a heat block at 75 °C.

substeps.instruction: Calculate total volume based on islet count: 75 islets (10+10 µL), 100 islets (15+10 µL), 150 islets (15+15 µL), 200 islets (20+15 µL), 250+ islets (20+20 µL).

steps.title: Prepare DNase Kit
steps.instruction: Remove DNase kit from -20 °C and thaw at room temperature.

steps.title: Lysate Preparation
steps.instruction: Add 100 µL 100% ETOH to each lysate and vortex to mix (continue vortexing until thawed if lysates were previously frozen).

steps.title: RNA Binding
steps.instruction: Prepare a Micro Filter Cartridge Assembly by inserting a cartridge into a labeled round-bottom microcentrifuge tube.

substeps.instruction: Pipet 150 µL of lysate/ETOH mixture into the cartridge and centrifuge for 00:00:10 at 18400 rcf.
Repeat for the final 150 µL of lysate.

steps.title: Filter Washing
steps.instruction: Wash the RNA bound to the filter using Wash Solutions.

substeps.instruction: Add 180 µL Wash Solution 1 to the cartridge and centrifuge for 00:00:10 at 18400 rcf.
Remove cartridge, discard tube contents, and replace cartridge back into the tube.
Add 180 µL Wash Solution 2/3 to the cartridge and centrifuge for 00:00:10 at 18400 rcf.
Repeat the Wash Solution 2/3 step for a total of two washes.

steps.title: Drying the Filter
steps.instruction: Centrifuge for 00:01:00 at 21300 rcf to remove residual liquid from the filter.

steps.title: RNA Elution
steps.instruction: Elute RNA from the filter in two steps.

substeps.instruction: Transfer cartridge to a new, prelabeled round-bottom microcentrifuge tube.
Add the first volume of pre-heated Elution Solution to the cartridge filter and centrifuge for 00:00:30 at 18400 rcf.
Repeat with the second aliquot of Elution Solution.
Remove and discard the filter cartridge.

steps.title: RNA Transfer
steps.instruction: Transfer the Elution Solution containing RNA from the round-bottom tube to a labeled RNase-free microcentrifuge tube.

steps.title: DNase Treatment
steps.instruction: Treat the RNA samples with DNase to remove DNA contamination.

substeps.instruction: Add 5 µL DNase Buffer and 1 µL DNase to each RNA sample and vortex gently.
Incubate samples in a 37 °C water bath for 00:20:00.
Add 5 µL Inactivation Reagent to each sample and vortex gently.
Incubate samples at 25 °C for 00:02:00, vortexing gently after 1 minute and again after the incubation is complete.
Carefully pipet the supernatant into a new, prelabeled RNase-free tube without disturbing the pellet.

steps.title: Quality Assessment
steps.instruction: Assess the quality and concentration of the recovered RNA using the method of choice.

steps.title: Reagent Maintenance
steps.instruction: Replenish Wash Solution bottles with 100% ETOH, mark, and date the bottles.

substeps.instruction: Add 10.5 mL 100% ETOH to Wash Solution 1 bottle.
Add 22.4 mL 100% ETOH to Wash Solution 2/3 bottle.
